title: WAC 192-510-025, What wages are reportable to the department for premium assessment purposes?

passages.question: Do the 401(k) deferrals and Section 125 health premiums stay in the wages that carry both premiums?
passages.excerpt: (1) Examples of wages reportable to the department for premium assessment purposes include, but are not limited to: (a) Salary or hourly wages; ... (c) Commissions or piecework; (d) Bonuses; ... (2) Examples of what the department will not consider wages include, but are not limited to: ...
